A '''laser actuator''' was a component of some [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], utilizing a [[Quad-helix prismatic crystal/Legends|quad-helix prismatic crystal]] to generate a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blast.<ref name="SWS" /> Custom modified laser actuators with larger [[Energization crystal/Legends|energization crystal]]s were built into the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannon]] to increase its energy output.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
